pt_zoram_essence: Elaria. Tinker, on the Strand, which mostly means mending pulleys. I work at the north-west end by the water. Metal, a crystal out of a vein, and a steady hand. Bring me the first two and I will see about the third.
pt_zoram_wood: Thalanil, woodwright. I teach at the north end of the Strand, a few steps from the sawmill. Driftwood, mostly. The sea brings it in already seasoned. A plank is only a boat that has not happened yet.
zoram_sentinel: Lookout Taelanor. This is the north point of Zoram Strand and my post is the water. I watch it so the others can sleep. Blackfathom is up the coast from here, and what lives in it has started coming down to look at us.
zoram_innkeeper: Lysaia. This is the inn - the middle of the Strand, such as it is. Four beds and a fire that does not go out. It is not much, but it is dry, and it is the last one west before the sea.
zoram_flight_master: Aleris, wind-rider. The roost is beside the inn. Astranaar inland, and nothing else from here. The coast road is for people with time, and nobody on this coast has any.
zoram_boatwright: Illyen, boatwright. My slip is on the west shore of the Strand. The boats go where the tide lets them. Mind the planks, they are wet. I build faster than the naga break them, so far, and I name each boat after someone who was useful.
ct_zoram: I train every discipline on the Strand, beside the inn. Yes, I know whose name I carry. My mother was devout. I have taught each of the disciplines at one time or another - show me where you are, and bring coin.
pt_zoram_forge: Mining and smithing, both halves or neither. I teach by the east gate. I should tell you the Strand has a sawmill and no forge - salt air eats a bellows in a season. Take your ore inland to Astranaar to work it.
pt_zoram_hide: Ilyenna, tanner. South of the inn. Hide, leather, cloth, and the meat off the same carcass - pay once and I teach the lot, cooking included. On this coast that means crab. You get used to crab.
zoram_fisher: Maelis. Old Maelis, and I have earned it. I fish the south end of the Strand. Silverfin ran thick here once. Now the murlocs cut my nets and the crabs empty my traps, and I am too old to argue with either.
pt_zoram_herbs: I teach herbs at the south end of the Strand. Every weed is a medicine to someone, and the ones that grow in salt are stronger than they look. I will show you which to pull and what to do with it after. The second part is where people go wrong.
